product.name: Nermosa Women Embroidery Solid A-Line Kurta and Pant Set with Dupatta
product.product_type: A-Line Kurta and Pant Set with Dupatta
product.description: An embroidered solid A-line kurta set paired with matching pants and a dupatta, designed for festive occasions, family functions, parties, office wear and casual outings.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally like the set for its elegant embroidery, attractive colors, A-line silhouette, comfort, fit and value for money. The main concerns are occasional color differences from the pictures, a few quality and finishing complaints, and one review mentioning that the dupatta was shorter than expected. One reviewer also reported that the sleeve appearance differed from expectations.

fit.note: Multiple reviewers describe the fit as good, comfortable or true to size. One reviewer specifically described the fitting as perfect.

color_accuracy.note: Several customers liked the color, but some Morepeach buyers reported that the delivered color differed from what they expected from the pictures.

dupattas.note: The dupatta completes the outfit and is described as lightweight by one reviewer, but another reviewer found it slightly short.

buying_advice.size_advice: The set is available from S to 5XL and reviews generally indicate good or true-to-size fitting. Still, check the size chart before ordering.
buying_advice.weather_advice: The available reviews do not provide enough evidence to make a strong hot-weather or cold-weather recommendation.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the elegant embroidery, flattering A-line silhouette, complete kurta-pant-dupatta combination and strong value at ₹799. If the customer cares about exact color matching or premium fabric quality, mention the mixed feedback before recommending it.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Give a concise overview covering the embroidered A-line design, kurta-pant-dupatta combination, fit, price, colors, sizes and the most important review insights.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend it for customers looking for an affordable and elegant ethnic outfit. Highlight the strong appearance, comfort, fit and value signals while mentioning the occasional color and finishing concerns.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_summer: Do not make a strong summer-weather claim because the available reviews do not provide enough reliable evidence about breathability or heat suitability.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that it has an A-line silhouette and several buyers reported good, comfortable or true-to-size fitting. Recommend checking the size chart before purchasing.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_color: Mention that Green, Morepeach, Purple and Rust are available, but disclose that some customers reported the delivered Morepeach color differed from what they expected from the pictures.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Explain that most reviews are positive about quality and embroidery, but some customers reported average material, finishing or brightness. Do not describe the fabric as premium with certainty because the material specification is unavailable.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_dupatta: Confirm that the outfit includes a dupatta. Mention that one reviewer found it lightweight while another reported that it was slightly short.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: Prioritize similar ethnic kurta sets based on the customer's occasion, budget, preferred silhouette, fabric requirements and color preference.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not recommend this product solely because of its 4.3 rating. Consider the customer's occasion, budget, desired fit, color accuracy expectations, fabric preference and need for a complete ethnic outfit.
